body:
已经使用炭炭一周多了，感受总体来说是可以的，页面简洁，没有花里胡哨的广告和不相干的功能（比如所谓的学习社区），软件和用户的交互体验也挺好。总体挺好，但个人还是希望加几个小功能。
首先，由于大多数单词都有多个意思，尤其是在个别释义较难记忆的情况下，在长按单词后的词典界面增加一个高光功能是否更有利于记忆？还有，如果高光标记后的对应释义也会同步显示在List界面就更好了。
其次，查单词的时候，我会有看例句的习惯，但对于不懂的词，打算选中查找的时候，只能在手机系统的词典查，也不能直接标记该生词。个人感觉，将单词详情页出现的词（比如释义例句和原声例句）都单独设置可以点击直接查询的功能，会不会更好？
 以上就是一点小建议，不懂技术层面的知识，个人建议中如有班门弄斧的地方，还请包涵🙏🏻

它趁我种树的时候自己发病突然更新了！！！更新完我种的时候树也没了？？！？！？到底想干嘛forest？太生气了！界面丑也就算了，趁我种树的时候自己更新还把树整没了？？！？😭
我从19年开始用的forest，从初中用到大学，非常喜欢它简约的画风和漂亮的有设计感的树，种满树的土地看起来很有成就感。可是从什么时候开始，从买断制变成了会员制，多了很多花里胡哨的活动和新功能，不过好在forest保留了老会员的权限。今天！！我的forest突然自己更新！新的UI界面让我很不适应，太难受了😭我怀念过去习惯的样子，什么时候能改回来？？？产品经理在干嘛？？突然这么大改动会有很多人不习惯的！

title: 過剰なクリフハンガー
body:
テンプレートのストーリーが多いですが、そうで無いものも最近は増えてきて。楽しく視聴しています。課金者です。

ただ、各話の最後で起きた出来事が、次の話では「起きなかったこと」になっている演出が頻繁にあるのが気になります。

例えば、前話の最後ではあるものを隠している布をめくって中身を見られるところまで描かれているのに、次話では同じ場面に戻り、布をめくる直前で止められて、結局見られていなかったことになります。

次の話を見てもらうためのクリフハンガーだとは思いますが、前話で実際に描いた出来事そのものをなかったことにするのは、物語への没入感が損なわれます。
次話で展開を巻き戻してストーリーを変更する演出はやめてほしいです。

ひとつとても痛いのは、突然使えなくなったメッセージ内でのmemory機能です。クリエイティブや様々な他データ関連も後から参照できるように膨大な量を様々な会話からセーブしていたので、とてもmemory機能を活用していました。ですが、突然の廃止で全てのデータが飛んでしまい、もても活用しにくくなっています。パーソナライズやトーク履歴では全てが追いつかず、本当に困っています。
もし可能であれば、トーク内のmemory機能の復活を希望しています。
これからも様々なサービス活用させていただきます。

title: この企業に利益を上げさせない方がいい。（星-5）
body:
今回あまりにもこの企業が酷いので初めてレビューを書かさせていただきます。

作品数では高く評価されがちですが、実際使うと見たい作品はほぼ有料作品となっていました。また、はっきり言って詐欺とやってることは変わらないと思います。私自身、今思えば押し切られる形で初回契約をさせられました。その時「初回登録でポイントがもらえてそのポイントは映画を見る時などにも利用できるよ」と言われ、私自身継続利用する予定はなかったため「解約後も利用できますか」と聞き返しました。すると、「できる」との返事が返ってきたのを確かに確認しています。しかし、ちょうど翌月の頭から仕組みが変わり、解約後はポイントの使用ができなくなってしまいました。私が質問をした時点では変更が確定しており、それを伝えることもできたはずです。はっきり言って詐欺に等しいと思います。これ以外にも不満はまだあります。契約はもう二度としたく無いのですが、これ以上売り上げが伸びてしまうと、独占配信などが多くなってしまい、その他の動画配信サービスの力も衰えかねないと思います。なのでご協力よろしくお願いいたします。

title: 改善要望
body:
以下の①〜⑤を担当の方へお伝えいただけると幸いです。　
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
①．『字幕をオン/オフできる作品』を増やしてください。　
※新作だけでなく『旧作』にも遡って対応していただきたいです。　
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
②．『マンガや本を複数条件で詳細検索できる機能』を追加してください。　
※その際の条件には下記の要素も組込んでいただきたいです。　
『期間限定』の『無料』と『値引』は、一緒くたにせず『別々』に指定できるようにしてください。　
『いくら以上からいくら以下まで』という『値段の範囲』を指定できるようにしてください。　
『何ページ以上から何ページ以下まで』という『ページ数の範囲』を指定できるようにしてください。　
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
③．『チャージする際の還元は廃止して結構』ですから、その代わり『使用するポイントを含めた購入価格に対してポイント還元』していただきたいです。　
※そもそもチャージにはデメリットが有るので、アプリでも直接決済できるようにするか、アプリからブラウザへ自動遷移して決済させるようにして、チャージ自体も廃止した方が良いと思います。　
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
④．『ブック割引クーポン』を導入し、頻繁に配布してください。　
他社の電子書籍サービスと比べた場合、ポイント還元だけでは『お得感が弱い』ので『割引クーポンは必須』だと思います。　
※それ以外にも『他社サービスの良い点』を積極的に取入れていただきたいです。　
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
⑤．『ブック初回購入で最大95%引き(上限750円)』という９月に始まった施策は非常に残念です。　
これだと『施策が始まる前に購入していた人』から見れば『不公平』以外の何物でもないので、初回ではなく『施策が始まって以降の１回目』に変更してください。　
※初めての施策なのに『既存のユーザーを蔑ろにする』のは『釣った魚に餌を与えない』のと同じなので、こんな事をしていると多くのユーザーから見離されますよ！　
　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　
以上、是非ご検討くださいますよう何卒よろしくお願いいたします。

title: Glad to be back! Absolutely loving YouTube TV
body:
Absolutely love being back with YouTube TV! Signed up the 1st after being subscribed to another platform off and on since 2022 and I’m loving YouTube TV even more since! Initially made the switch for 2 months back in ‘24 but due to financial constraints I was unable to keep YouTube TV at that time, switched financial institutions in September ’25 and now my bank is accepted by Google for YouTube TV payments! That’s a plus in itself lol 

Now onto a few of the things that I love about YouTube TV compared to the other platform I was formerly subscribed too. 

1. User Interface: absolutely love how YouTube TV uses the exact same features and functionality as the traditional YouTube app. Makes navigating the app much easier and more fluid.

2. Content: absolutely love having the lineup and content that I do with YouTube TV, certain channels for programming I follow and watch on a weekly basis are carried by YouTube TV, with the former platform, I had to do an outside 3rd party subscription to watch the show. Makes it nice knowing that I can save that extra money now. 

3. Features: absolutely two of the best features with YouTube TV that I love are the MULTIVIEW and Last watched channel. Neither were available with the other platform, Multiview makes it completely convenient for me as a sports fan, both me and my wife are nfl fans and it makes it easier being able to pull up Broncos and Bengals games on the same screen without missing plays. Last watched channel is another useful feature as I tend to watch different programming quite often so it makes it nice to get back and forth between networks quickly. 

All in all, definitely worth making the switch for anyone else who wants to save money. 

5/5 for sure

title: Not At All What a Editing App Should Be.
body:
I’ve used CapCut for years, marked as the first ever editing app I discovered when I first decided to begin editing simple clips on TikTok, but since such an era, it has completely fallen off and has become just another pay to use application. 

For starters, CapCut’s many features such as various effects and transitions that had once been free are now blocked by a paywall which requires you to have some form of CapCut Pro. There’s generally nothing wrong with paid featured, especially if your app needs funding, but the amount of effects that now require pro is absurd. And what’s even more insane is the pricing for these pro features. CapCut is charging you $11.99 which is $109.99 YEARLY for a editing program that is a simpler version of other editing apps. Video Star, a more complex editing platform that has better resources, charges less yearly—only $34.99. And worst of all, CapCut is charging you $109.99 a year for a few cheap effects and templetes along with “perks” that usually come free with any editing app. Of course, that can’t be the end for CapCut, because the price I listed is for the STANDARD package. The Ultra package is starting up to $800 YEARLY.

I understand if apps need to make a few green bucks to get compensation for their app and to fund it further, but this pricing seems over zealous. It would be one thing if CapCut was a professional application, but not many professionals even use CapCut from what I’ve seen. Most use the classic Adobe which charges $275.88 yearly, and at first glance it seems way too pricey, maybe even more pricer than CapCut. But the difference between them is that Adobe is for PROFESSIONALS meanwhile CapCut is advertised for TIKTOK editing (and is charging MORE for Ultra which is more than double of Adobe’s yearly price) and supposably a beginner friendly option. But how can a beginner even begin to navigate different features if half the effects are hidden by a pay wall (along with better quality)? Not to mention the fact that CapCut just doesn’t work the same as it used to.

CapCut ran pretty smooth in its early years. But as I came back to this editing program as a last resort, I’ve figured out that the quality has severely went down. I have found quite a few bugs throughout the whole app, including one that frustrates me so much to the point I can’t even use CapCut because I NEED that one feature to create my videos. The Text-To-Speech feature. It’s just like any other effect in CapCut—only around 10 free options before it starts shoving pay walls in your face. But that isn’t even the problem. The problem is that for whatever reason, mid-way through creating my video, the text-to-speech button is just… gone. It’s not even there when I click the text box. I’ve tried checking if the app needs an update, but it never does. And I tried redownloading the app which temporarily fixed the problem before it went right back to acting up. So, it’s safe to say that CapCut’s features are not only expensive, but not at all reliable. 

I could go on, probably look more into the app to catch more things wrong about the app, but this is just a review to say that CapCut’s quality has gone down and it isn’t worth the hassle to get the app. And usually I’d try to be respectful and hope that this app gets better in the future (which I hope it does), but it’s gotten so clear that CapCut is only concerned with pro features and nothing more that I’m pretty sure it won’t change no matter how many bad reviews they receive.

title: Awful experience
body:
I am very disappointed with CapCut’s student discount process.

CapCut offered me a 50% student discount, showing a price of $9.99 per month. The offer was presented very clearly, with a specific option to select the student discount and verify student status through a university email address. I completed that verification exactly as requested.

However, when I was charged, CapCut billed me approximately twice the advertised student price. The 50% discount was not applied.

Now, instead of simply correcting the charge, the refund/dispute process requires extensive documentation and paperwork. It feels as though I have to prepare the equivalent of a mortgage application just to recover money that should never have been charged in the first place.

A student discount should be simple: advertise the price, verify student status, and charge the advertised amount. Customers should not have to spend hours gathering documents to correct an incorrect charge.

This experience has significantly reduced my trust in CapCut’s billing practices.

To make matters worse, CapCut’s customer service bot later told me that they currently do not offer any student discount at all. That directly contradicts the student discount offer that was shown to me and that I completed the verification process for.

title: ★★★★★ Golazo Made Me a Soccer Addict
body:
I lived in Latin America for years and watched plenty of soccer there, but it was almost always in Spanish. Spanish is my second language, so while I enjoyed the games, I never really got immersed in the leagues, players, clubs and stories surrounding them.

That started changing when I got hooked on the World Cup, and Paramount+ and CBS Sports Golazo have taken it to an entirely different level.

Being able to watch Champions League and Serie A, and then having Golazo shows that actually explain what is happening around the soccer world, has turned me into a genuine soccer addict. I now follow clubs and players across several European leagues and find myself planning my days around matches.

A huge part of that is the Golazo crew. Hannah, Nico, Mim, Geoff and the rest of the team make soccer informative without making it feel like homework. They’re knowledgeable, funny, opinionated and genuinely enjoyable to watch. I often have Golazo playing even when there isn’t a match on.

Paramount+ has become one of my most-used streaming services almost entirely because of soccer. If your goal was to turn casual American viewers into passionate soccer fans, it worked on me.

Five stars. Keep investing in soccer and keep the Golazo crew together. ⚽

title: Money Grabber App
body:
This app is not as easy to use as it used to be. You see, you have an energy saver now. This wouldn’t be an issue, if it wasn’t completely useless. 
The energy meter only goes to 25. So you would think the lessons would cost you like an energy or two, to do proper lessons, but no. The lessons cost 15 energy, which means you can only do a single lesson a day, because the energy recharges only after 24 hours.
There are ways around this. You get a free +5 energy every hour, and you can also watch ads for +5 energy. However, this becomes aggravating, since you’d have to claim the +5 free and watch an ad, do a lesson, watch two +5 recharge ads, do a lesson. These ads give the app money, which would be the only way to make profit as a large portion of the app’s subscription members were not pleased with the 2024/2025 AI use.
Oh, but the subscription is also where the other half of the money grab comes in, because with a subscription you get UNLIMITED energy. 🫩
The app would be much less aggravating if they would raise the limit on the energizer. So that we could get at least three or four lessons in before we ever have to use ads (because you ALSO see ads at the end of EVERY lesson no matter what). And maybe so that we can make mistakes without having to wait to correct them…? Especially on the time limited lessons, where some people are just unable to match the amount of words under 1 minute and 45 seconds.

title: Broken app with no real support stay away!
body:
Polymarket’s app is plagued by severe lag and glitches that make reliable trading nearly impossible. The score/odds do not update in real time, so holding a position until the end of a match is not feasible—you’re flying blind while the market moves.
Even worse, selling a position frequently triggers an immediate buy of the opposite side. This happens so fast that you lose money on the forced reverse trade before you can react. These aren’t minor annoyances; they directly eat into your bankroll on live events.
I’ve repeatedly experienced both issues during matches. The lag alone makes timing exits impossible, and the sell-then-instant-buy bug turns what should be a clean exit into an unwanted opposite position. Until these core trading problems are fixed, I cannot recommend the app for serious or even casual use. Your money is at risk every time the app lags or glitches. body: FOX One’s “My Stuff” and DVR are an absolute mess. The app records programs I never asked it to record, and there is no obvious or accessible way to see what is being recorded, cancel unwanted recordings, stop a series, or properly manage the DVR. I can spend 20 minutes deleting unwanted recordings, only to have more appear. The Recorded Episodes section makes no sense—some programs record while others don’t, recordings can disappear, and there is no normal way to delete or manage them or control how many episodes are retained. My Stuff also adds programs I never selected and can remove things I intentionally saved. The home screen constantly rearranges itself, moves Previously Watched and Latest for You around, resets unexpectedly, and floods the screen with FOX-selected recommendations instead of simply letting me choose what I want to see. Recordings can appear late, disappear after being recorded, or fail to record altogether. Playback is frustrating too, including jumping backward to portions I have already watched when I try to fast-forward through commercials. I have also had problems with repeated sign-ins and situations where deleting and reinstalling the app seems necessary. FOX One needs to stop trying to be clever and fix the basic DVR and library functions: give customers actual control over what is recorded, what stays in My Stuff, and what appears on the home screen.

body: I love this app so much, but typing in any calendar notes has been frustrating for years now. If you try to add text anywhere other than at the end it will only type the first letter and then jump to the end. Or, if you’re trying to backspace it will skip the spaces so you end up deleting more than you meant to. This issue has been happening for several years over multiple devices so I know it’s not a problem with the device or with the app needing to be reinstalled. Is there any plan to fix this?
